glosses: holder of a court office responsible for serving the royal table, especially at the Safavid court; compare Russian stolnik.

o.text: From süfrə + -çi. Coined in early 2010s to replace ofisiant, a Russian borrowing; it is unclear whether the coinage was made with reference to the historical sense. The term has been used since (above all in job announcements), although it is relatively rare compared to ofisiant.
From əylə- + -c. Coined by Azerbaijani writer Rəsul Rza.
Unadapted borrowing from Turkish keşfet. Compare eksplor.
